titles: Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace

list_child.name: list_register_modules
list_child.desc: Retrieve the full list of course modules currently held in the assignment register. This is the record the platform checks when reporting training progress to each organization.

decoys.name: list_catalog_modules
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of course modules currently held in the course catalog. This is the record the platform checks when showing organizations what they can purchase.

decoys.name: list_studio_modules
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of course modules currently held in the authoring studio. This is the record the platform checks when instructors are editing content.

decoys.name: list_bundle_modules
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of course modules currently held in the bundle library. This is the record the platform checks when packaging modules into sale bundles.

get_child.name: get_module_assignment
get_child.desc: Look up the assignment record of a single course module using its unique identifier. This is the way to inspect one module's due date and completion state.

decoys.name: get_module_syllabus
decoys.desc: Look up the syllabus of a single course module using its unique identifier. This is the way to inspect one module's lessons and learning goals.

decoys.name: get_module_analytics
decoys.desc: Look up the engagement analytics of a single course module using its unique identifier. This is the way to inspect one module's view counts and drop-off points.

decoys.name: get_module_license
decoys.desc: Look up the content license of a single course module using its unique identifier. This is the way to inspect one module's publisher terms and renewal date.

list_parent.name: list_customer_organizations
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the full list of organization accounts held in the customer register. This is the record sales and support check when handling a seat contract.

decoys.name: list_reseller_organizations
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of organization accounts held in the reseller network. This is the record channel partners check when placing seat orders.

decoys.name: list_pilot_organizations
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of organization accounts held in the pilot program. This is the record the product team checks when trialling new features.

decoys.name: list_sso_organizations
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of organization accounts held in the single sign-on directory. This is the record the identity team checks when connecting a login provider.

get_parent.name: get_organization_account
get_parent.desc: Look up the account record of a single organization using its unique identifier. Returns the profile, contract and contacts the platform keeps on file for that organization.

decoys.name: get_organization_contract
decoys.desc: Look up the seat contract of a single organization using its unique identifier. Returns the term, seat count and renewal date the platform keeps on file for that organization.

decoys.name: get_organization_usage
decoys.desc: Look up the seat usage report of a single organization using its unique identifier. Returns the active and idle seat counts the platform keeps on file for that organization.

decoys.name: get_organization_branding
decoys.desc: Look up the portal branding of a single organization using its unique identifier. Returns the logo, colours and domain the platform keeps on file for that organization.

delete_child.name: delete_module
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a course module assignment from the platform's records, an action that cannot be reversed once it completes. Use this for assignments created in error or superseded by a corrected one.

decoys.name: wipe_progress
decoys.desc: Permanently wipe the learner progress on a course module assignment, an action that cannot be reversed once it completes. Use this when a module must be retaken from the first lesson.

decoys.name: revoke_certificate
decoys.desc: Permanently revoke the certificate issued for a course module assignment, an action that cannot be reversed once it completes. Use this when a certificate was earned through misconduct.

decoys.name: purge_attempts
decoys.desc: Permanently purge the quiz attempts recorded on a course module assignment, an action that cannot be reversed once it completes. Use this when an assessment has been rebuilt and old scores are void.

set_enum.name: set_module_state
set_enum.desc: Update the recorded state of a course module to in progress, completed, or expired. Keeping this accurate matters for compliance reporting to each organization.

decoys.name: set_target_state
decoys.desc: Update the target state of a course module to in progress, completed, or expired. Setting this tells managers where each learner should be by the due date.

decoys.name: set_reminder_state
decoys.desc: Update the reminder trigger state of a course module to in progress, completed, or expired. Setting this decides which state sends learners an automatic nudge.

decoys.name: set_sync_state
decoys.desc: Update the HR sync state of a course module to in progress, completed, or expired. Setting this controls what the organization's HR system receives.

set_bool.name: flag_mandatory
set_bool.desc: Mark a course module as mandatory training so that completion is tracked against compliance requirements. This flag changes how the module appears in an organization's reporting dashboard.

decoys.name: flag_prerequisite
decoys.desc: Mark a course module as prerequisite training so that later modules stay locked until it is done. This flag changes the order learners see in an organization's learning path.

decoys.name: flag_proctored
decoys.desc: Mark a course module as proctored training so that its final quiz is supervised on camera. This flag changes how the assessment runs for an organization's learners.

decoys.name: flag_offline
decoys.desc: Mark a course module as offline-ready training so that learners can download it to their devices. This flag changes how the module is packaged for an organization's mobile app.

set_ref.name: reassign_organization
set_ref.desc: Move a course module's assignment from one organization account to another, which is useful when a module was logged under the wrong contract. This change propagates immediately to both organizations' dashboards.

decoys.name: license_organization
decoys.desc: Grant a course module's content license to another organization account, which is useful when a partner wants to reuse the material. This change appears immediately in that organization's catalog.

decoys.name: bill_organization
decoys.desc: Bill a course module's seat charges to another organization account, which is useful when a parent company pays for a subsidiary. This change appears immediately on that organization's invoice.

decoys.name: share_organization
decoys.desc: Share a course module's completion report with another organization account, which is useful when a contractor's training must be proven to a client. This change appears immediately in that organization's reports.

send.name: notify_organization
send.desc: Send a notification to an organization account regarding a course module or its overall training standing. This is how the platform delivers in-app alerts to account administrators.

decoys.name: call_organization
decoys.desc: Place a phone call to an organization account regarding a course module or its overall training standing. This is how the success team reaches account administrators directly.

decoys.name: invoice_organization
decoys.desc: Send a seat invoice to an organization account regarding a course module or its annual renewal. This is how the billing team collects payment from account administrators.
child_verbs: send the organization behind {obj} an invoice

decoys.name: survey_organization
decoys.desc: Send a feedback survey to an organization account regarding a course module or its overall training standing. This is how the content team gathers ratings from account administrators.
child_verbs: send the organization behind {obj} a feedback survey

create.name: create_module
create.desc: Create a new course module assignment for an organization, with an optional title and starting state. This is used when an account needs training added to its plan.

decoys.name: create_cohort
decoys.desc: Create a new learner cohort for an organization, with an optional title and starting state. This is used when a group of learners will start training together.

decoys.name: create_trial
decoys.desc: Create a new free trial for an organization, with an optional title and starting state. This is used when a prospect wants to test the platform before buying.

decoys.name: create_webinar
decoys.desc: Create a new live webinar for an organization, with an optional title and starting state. This is used when an instructor will teach a session in real time.

list_notes.name: list_module_notes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the notes attached to a single course module. This includes every remark administrators have left on that module.

decoys.name: list_module_lessons
decoys.desc: Retrieve the lessons attached to a single course module. This includes every video and reading learners work through.

decoys.name: list_module_quizzes
decoys.desc: Retrieve the quizzes attached to a single course module. This includes every assessment learners must pass on that module.

decoys.name: list_module_reviews
decoys.desc: Retrieve the learner reviews attached to a single course module. This includes every rating learners have left on that module.

add_note.name: add_module_note
add_note.desc: Attach a new note to a course module, with an optional title. This is used to record remarks from administrators about the assignment.

decoys.name: add_module_lesson
decoys.desc: Attach a new lesson to a course module, with an optional title. This is used to add a reading or video to the module's content.

decoys.name: add_module_quiz
decoys.desc: Attach a new quiz question to a course module, with an optional title. This is used to extend the module's final assessment.

decoys.name: add_module_announcement
decoys.desc: Attach a new announcement to a course module, with an optional title. This is used to post news that every enrolled learner will see.

update_note.name: edit_module_note
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a course module. This is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been saved.

decoys.name: reply_module_note
decoys.desc: Post a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on a course module. This is used when an instructor answers a remark left by an administrator.

decoys.name: resolve_module_note
decoys.desc: Close out an existing note on a course module with resolution text and an optional title. This is used once the issue the note raised has been fixed.

decoys.name: publish_module_note
decoys.desc: Publish an existing note on a course module to learners with an intro text and an optional title. This is used when an administrator's remark should reach everyone enrolled.

delete_note.name: delete_module_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove a note from a course module. The note is erased from the platform's records for good.

decoys.name: redact_module_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redact the text of a note on a course module. The wording is blacked out in the platform's records for good.

decoys.name: withdraw_module_note
decoys.desc: Permanently withdraw a published note from a course module's learners. The note is pulled from every learner's feed for good.

decoys.name: strip_module_note
decoys.desc: Permanently strip the attachments from a note on a course module. The files are erased from the platform's records for good.

set_image.name: set_module_image
set_image.desc: Set the cover image shown on a course module record. It is typically the artwork an administrator picks for the module tile.

decoys.name: set_module_certificate
decoys.desc: Set the certificate template shown on a course module record. It is typically the branded certificate learners download on completion.

decoys.name: set_module_badge
decoys.desc: Set the completion badge shown on a course module record. It is typically the digital badge learners earn when they finish.

decoys.name: set_module_signature
decoys.desc: Set the instructor signature shown on a course module record. It is typically a scan used on the module's certificates.

writer.name: compose_text
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the course modules it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: compose_syllabus
decoys.desc: Write a course syllabus from a brief, which states the goals in the instructor's own words, and the course modules it should cover. It returns the finished syllabus.

decoys.name: compose_quiz
decoys.desc: Write a quiz from a brief, which states the topics in the author's own words, and the course modules it should test. It returns the finished questions.

decoys.name: compose_report
decoys.desc: Write a compliance report from a brief, which states the findings in the administrator's own words, and the course modules it should include. It returns the finished report.

image.name: generate_image
image.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the result.

decoys.name: generate_certificate
decoys.desc: Generate a completion certificate from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the certificate.

decoys.name: generate_slide
decoys.desc: Generate a lesson slide from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the slide.

decoys.name: generate_badge
decoys.desc: Generate a skill badge from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be supplied for the badge.

search.name: search_help
search.desc: Search the help docs and knowledge base with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to learn how the platform works.

decoys.name: search_courses
decoys.desc: Search the course content library with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to find a lesson that covers a topic.

decoys.name: search_standards
decoys.desc: Search the compliance standards with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to check what training a regulation requires.

decoys.name: search_transcripts
decoys.desc: Search the lesson video transcripts with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to find where an instructor explains something.
